game_title: LEGO BATMAN: LEGACY OF THE DARK KNIGHT
platform: PC (Steam, Epic) / PS5 / Xbox Series X|S

beats.label: hook
beats.text: TT Games built Batman's full origin story across 6 eras of his career — and launched the whole thing to Kiss from a Rose.

beats.label: gameplay
beats.text: Start as Bruce Wayne training with the League of Shadows. Unlock new Batman suits for each era — each with its own mechanics, allies, and a slice of Gotham's open world. Team up with Robin, Nightwing, and Batgirl as the story advances.

beats.label: standout
beats.text: From the makers of LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga — this is TT Games' most cinematic project, built around one hero's complete arc across 6 distinct gameplay chapters, not a rotating roster.

beats.label: cta
beats.text: Releases May 22 on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S. Wishlist now on Steam.

spoken_text: TT Games built Batman's full origin story across 6 eras of his career — and launched the whole thing to Kiss from a Rose. Start as Bruce Wayne training with the League of Shadows. Unlock new Batman suits for each era — each with its own mechanics, allies, and a slice of Gotham's open world. Team up with Robin, Nightwing, and Batgirl as the story advances. From the makers of LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga — this is TT Games' most cinematic project, built around one hero's complete arc across 6 distinct gameplay chapters, not a rotating roster.
